name: FUN_PROCESS_EXEC_HISTORY
description: This table contains the properties of each execution of an allocation process or allocation process set, including the name of the allocation process or allocation process set, date and time of the execution, parameter values, and other information.

columns.name: PROCESS_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for process execution history.

columns.name: PARENT_PROCESS_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the parent of the process execution.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Allocation Process.

columns.name: PROCESS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the executed process. Possible values are ALLOCATION_PROCESS, ALLOCATION_PROCESS_SET, AV_CREATION, SOURCE_DATA_DEFINITION...etc.

columns.name: PROCESS_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Used to identify the request where it belongs. Possible values are ALLOCATION, AV_PROVISIONING, DATA_EXTRACT, etc

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifies the ESS scheduler request.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the Allocation Process execution. Possible values are SCHEDULED, RUNNING, FAILED and COMPLETED.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message details if execution fails.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: Stores the schedule information

columns.name: REQUEST_PARAMETER_INFO
columns.description: Details of the Request Parameters.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_START_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the start date and time of the schedule.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_END_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the end date and time of the schedule.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Start time of the process execution

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: End time of the process execution

columns.name: LAST_RUN_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the last run time of the process as part of schedule

columns.name: NEXT_RUN_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the next run time of the process as part of schedule

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
